name: flow-mcp
description: Build, check and run Flow discrete-event simulation models with your AI assistant, on your own computer.
long_description: Lets your assistant read Flow's model format, validate models with Flow's own validator, run them with Flow's simulation engine (several replications, with 95% confidence intervals and warnings about bottlenecks and overload), try a range of values for a parameter, trace a run to find out why a model misbehaves, edit saved models, save them as files, and open them in Flow in your browser, either as a new model or as an update to the model they were exported from. Everything runs on your computer; models are plain JSON files in one folder.

tools.name: flow_get_schema
tools.description: Flow's model format: generation protocol, common mistakes, and any section on request.

tools.name: flow_list_models
tools.description: List the model files in your Flow models folder.

tools.name: flow_read_model
tools.description: Read a model file, e.g. one exported from Flow.

tools.name: flow_validate_model
tools.description: Check a model with Flow's own validator.

tools.name: flow_run_model
tools.description: Run a model for several replications: results with 95% confidence intervals, routes, goals met or missed.

tools.name: flow_compare_models
tools.description: Compare two versions with the same random numbers: which differences are real, which could be chance.

tools.name: flow_run_over_time
tools.description: Queue lengths, utilisation and work in progress period by period.

tools.name: flow_sweep_parameter
tools.description: Try a range of values for one parameter (e.g. number of staff): a table of results and goals met per value.

tools.name: flow_trace_run
tools.description: Trace one run: which rules fired or never did, who was left where, and the event log.

tools.name: flow_edit_model
tools.description: Change parts of a saved model file without re-sending the whole model.

tools.name: flow_save_model
tools.description: Save a model as a file Flow can import. Never overwrites by default.

tools.name: flow_open_in_app
tools.description: Open a model file in Flow in your browser: add it as a new model, or update the model it was exported from.

models_folder.title: Flow models folder
models_folder.description: Where models are read from and saved to. Leave empty to use Documents/Flow models.

check_for_updates.title: Check for updates
check_for_updates.description: Once each time it starts, fetch a small version file from Flow's website to tell you when a newer version is available. Sends nothing about you or your models.
